title: Session token generation & handling
summary: Assess session identifier entropy, fixation, and cookie security attributes.
steps: Capture session cookie(s) before/after login from auth_session or Set-Cookie.
Check flags: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite; Domain/Path scope vs app needs.
Login twice; compare tokens — predictable/sequential patterns are leads.
Session fixation: set anonymous session cookie, login, see if server keeps attacker-supplied id.
Logout / password change: confirm old session invalidated (replay old cookie → 401).
On PASS: evidenced weak flags, fixation, or non-rotation with impact path.
pass_signals: Missing Secure/HttpOnly on auth cookie with theft path
kill_signals: Strong flags + rotation on login + invalidate on logout
